sentences.text:
2. Heard learned Counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Ram Krishna Dubey,
counsel for the informant.

3. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 288 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station- Faizganj Behta, District- Budaun during pendency of the trial.

Hemendra vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175772688/
1
4. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
Neither the date and place nor the mode of payment of alleged amount by the informant to the applicant has been disclosed in the first information report.
At the moment, there is no evidence to link the applicant with the offence.
It is further contended that no amount has been credited in the account of the applicant.
The applicant is not the beneficiary of the alleged transactions.
The applicant has not forged any documents.
The applicant does not have any criminal history and is in jail since 12.6.2023.
In case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
5. Learned A.G.A. and counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

6. Having regard to the submissions made above and the fact that the applicant has remained confined for more than two months and after submission of the charge-sheet there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

7. Let the applicant, Hemendra involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned on the following conditions that:
i. the applicant shall not temper with the prosecution evidence; ii. the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witness; iii. the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
Order Date :- 18.8.2023 S.S.
